card.name: Upper end of a numeric range
card.fires_on: The linking word or the digit that comes right after 'to' or a dash in a numeric range, such as '5 to 60' or '30–40'. It marks the second number of a from-to range.

modes.label: Digit ending a range
modes.description: A digit of the upper number in a range of doses, weeks or percentages.
modes.example: in patients receiving oral doses from 5 to <<6>>0 mg fluphenazine hydrochlor

modes.label: Joiner inside a range
modes.description: The word 'to' or a dash that links the two ends of a range.
modes.example: peripheral lymphocyte count to 20%<< to>> 30% of baseline values because

modes.label: Unit after a range start
modes.description: A unit word right after the first number of a range, before 'to' or the second number.
modes.example: in pediatric patients is 7 days to 14<< days>>. Frequency 12 years to less
